articles.summary: Maximor set an uncompromising bar for its engineering team: top-tier international talent, and nothing below it. The challenge was never finding engineers. It was finding ones who cleared that bar, and finding them fast.
articles.title: How Maximor built its core engineering team with Contrario

articles.summary: Sunset had been trying to fill a critical customer success role since January. The problem was not a shortage of candidates. It was finding ones good enough to hire, fast enough to matter.
articles.title: How Sunset scaled its customer success team with Contrario

articles.summary: Crustdata had one account executive and needed a full sales team. The bar was the hard part: every hire had to be technical enough to sell a developer-first data product, and Crustdata had already turned away vendors that sent volume instead of quality.
articles.title: How Crustdata built its sales team with Contrario

articles.summary: When Liquid hired its first in-person engineer, the company was just its founder and a few contractors. Contrario placed that engineer, and every core engineering hire that followed, as Liquid grew from an early-stage startup into a Series A company.
articles.title: How Liquid built its core engineering team with Contrario
